# Biloute's blog

> Personal website and blog of Biloute (also publishing/credited elsewhere in this
> codebase as "Rahenda" — see [TODO: fill in] below for the canonical relationship
> between these two names). Site owner is a product manager with a background in
> engineering, DevOps/network engineering, and B2B sales, currently working in
> business development for enterprise telecom APIs. Site is in French (some content)
> and English (site chrome).

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) for making a
site's key information directly retrievable by AI assistants without requiring
HTML scraping.

## Profile

- [About / Profile](https://rahendarosmedi.com/about.html): Biography — career
  path from semiconductor manufacturing, to DevOps/network engineering, to
  product management, to Paris 2024 Olympics telecom infrastructure, to business
  development for enterprise APIs.
- [LLM-retrievable profile markdown](./about.md): structured, plain-markdown
  version of the same profile, intended for direct fetch by AI agents (mirrors
  the content of the About page above).
